lesson: Delegating many sequential full-file rewrites of one module (doctor.py got 8+ WOW64/convergence rounds) silently regresses earlier fixes: each worker rewrites the whole file focused on its immediate criterion and drops prior changes not restated in it. Per-round working-tree verification passes, but the FINAL committed file loses fixes. Mitigation: after a multi-round rewrite storm, verify every prior fix against the COMMITTED HEAD (git show HEAD:file), not the transient working tree; prefer surgical criteria that name the exact function to change; run the story-level review against committed state before pr_ready — it is the backstop that catches the accumulated regression.
